decisions.reason: The flagship reference electrometer sits at the core of the firm's dosimetry and accredited calibration competence and still meets aspirations in a growing industry, so there is no shortfall to trigger search for other uses of its resources.
The oncology risk management software supports the strategic convergence of machine and patient QA, and the expanding firm's slack lets it carry a software product whose adoption is still building.
The CT image quality phantom extends the firm's established imaging QA line, has a page of its own, and after only one year shows no shortfall against aspirations that would justify dropping it.

Although the mammography phantom is distant from the core, it fits the flagship imaging QA push, and growth slack allows the firm to tolerate its uncertain early results rather than drop it after one year.
The full field mammography phantom overlaps somewhat with Product D, which raises the chance of consolidation, but slack and the young imaging strategy favour keeping it for now.
This flagship multi-model imaging QA line embodies the firm's strategic direction, so management will protect it during its early market phase.
